sources.title: Analysis and Assessment of Gateway Process

sources.title: Corpus Hermeticum I, Poemandres
sources.edition: G.R.S. Mead translation, 1906; electronic witness with JMG editorial additions
sources.category: primary historical text in later translation/electronic witness
sources.readDepth: Sections1-16, electronic text; no manuscript collation
sources.finding: A revelatory dialogue and planetary cosmology. Literary speakers and divine Mind are not an identified modern extraterrestrial communicator.

sources.title: Corpus Hermeticum XI, Mind Unto Hermes
sources.edition: G.R.S. Mead translation, 1906; electronic witness with JMG editorial additions
sources.category: primary historical text in later translation/electronic witness
sources.readDepth: Sections1-22 electronic text, especially18-20; no manuscript collation
sources.finding: Contemplative expansion beyond bodily/time limits is a historical motif; the passage supplies neither SI electromagnetic quantities nor a measured transfer law.

sources.title: Binaural Beat: A Failure to Enhance EEG Power and Emotional Arousal
sources.readDepth: Primary publisher excerpts: abstract, participants, experimental design, EEG acquisition and results discussion
sources.finding: Fourteen participants; specific pink-noise embedded stimulation gave no enhancement of the tested EEG powers or measured arousal. A protocol-specific null, not proof against every possible binaural protocol.

sources.title: Transduction of the Geomagnetic Field as Evidenced from alpha-Band Activity in the Human Brain
sources.readDepth: Publisher search excerpts and authorinstitution metadata; direct full HTML returned403; not full audited
sources.finding: Reported alpha desynchronization after Earth-strength field rotations. Rotating approximately geomagnetic-strength fields is not the same stimulus as picotesla-scale ELF cavity fluctuations; no ET endpoint.
sources.status: Restricted prior result, dose and protocol comparison required

sources.title: A Unified Holographic Framework for neural computation and consciousness: From lipid membranes to the Schumann resonance
sources.readDepth: Publisher abstract, metadata and data-availability statement only
sources.finding: Proposes membrane-water-CSF/EM coupling and falsifiable strategies. Publisher states no data used. Not an experimentally verified connection.
sources.status: Contemporary theoretical lead, not confirmed mechanism

sources.title: Schumann-anchored golden ratio organization of human neural oscillations
sources.readDepth: Search-returned primary body excerpts: terminology, participants/datasets, abstract and availability; not full reanalysis
sources.finding: The author explicitly separates near-Schumann frequency naming from demonstrated EM coupling. The discovery meditation dataset is single-subject; additional public EEG validation datasets are used. Concurrent geophysical measurements are required to test coupling.
sources.status: New prior-art lead for independent selection/null-model audit; no ET evidence
